TESLA: Brookshire, TX, Megafactory, August 8th, 2026

The Megafactory produced its first Megapack 3 last week and ran over to see. I did not see the Megapack, but I did see a tons of newly delivered boxes of equipment. Half of the southern fence line had large crates in rows covering the lot.

More foundation work for the large stainless tanks was taking place. The refurbished entrances on the north fence line are complete. And large white trusses are staged outside the 600k sq ft facility. 

It was a gorgeous day for a flyover.

A massive 88 pic Subscriber Photo-Thread is attached. Sub it up and take a look.

Enjoy!
